{{Quote|Hey, Solo! Over here&hellip; I think we've got something for you!|The individual, to [[Han Solo]]|<ref name="PowerGem">"[[The Power Gem]]"</ref>}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was present aboard the the [[Junkfort Station/Legends|Junkfort Station]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="PowerGem" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="0 ABY">"[[The Power Gem]]" is set after the events of {{Film|IV}} and before the [[Evacuation of Yavin 4]], and it therefore takes place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> This station banned [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], but when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]<nowiki/>visited the station while searching for a [[power gem]], this individual and their [[Unidentified alien Junkfort Station cantina patron|alien]] [[Unidentified alien Junkfort Station cantina patron|companion]] decided to try and capture Solo and claim his [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] from [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]].
